purpose: Isolate the incremental economic value of residualizing the momentum score against SPY (rung C -> rung D), separate from concentration (rung B) and universe return (rung A). This is an ablation of the already-canonical Market-Residual Momentum definition, not a new candidate strategy.

canonicalInputs.window: engine.universe.daily_date_range() default, same window the canonical V1 run uses
canonicalInputs.costModel: identical per-symbol spread_for_universe estimate and ALPACA_COMMISSION_BPS used by the canonical run

C.rule: plain trailing-return momentum, top-N, identical lookback/skip/topN/rebalance/universe/costs to D

D.isolates: incremental residualization value = D minus C

notApplicable.E: Residual momentum + absolute-momentum filter is NOT implemented as a distinct rung: the canonical Market-Residual Momentum spec has no absolute-filter stage, so D and F (the canonical full strategy) are the same run. Adding a new absolute-filter variant would be a new, separately preregistered hypothesis, not a rung of this ablation, and is explicitly out of scope here.

designConstraints: Rungs C and D differ ONLY in score formula (raw cumulative return vs. market-residual cumulative compounded return); lookback, skip_days, top_n, rebalance_frequency, universe, membership, dates, and cost model are byte-identical between them.

Rungs A and B are computed ONCE (same PIT bars, same membership_at, same equity-curve index, same seed) and reused as the shared baseline for both C and D -- not independently reseeded per rung -- so the C-vs-D comparison against A/B is paired, not two independently noisy estimates.
No parameter search on rung C or rung D: both use the canonical V1 lookback/skip/topN (126/5/5). This is an ablation, not a new neighbor sweep.
A paired bootstrap over rebalance-period return differences (D minus C) is the only uncertainty estimate computed; it is reported as an interval, not as a pass/fail gate.
prohibited: tuning rung C's or rung D's parameters away from the canonical V1 values
adding a rung E/F absolute-filter variant without a separate preregistration
writing this run to engine/logging_db.py's runs or portfolio_runs tables (diagnostic only, same discipline as engine/compare_filters.py and engine/compare_universe.py)
treating this experiment's outcome as a validation gate for Market-Residual Momentum -- it is attribution, not a replacement for research/frozen_v1_protocol.json's validation suite
interpretationRule: If D materially and consistently improves on C (positive mean and median return/CAGR/Sharpe difference across the paired bootstrap, CI excluding zero), residualization is adding selection value beyond plain momentum. If C is approximately equal to D, the residualization step is not earning its complexity. If C beats D, residualizing has removed useful momentum exposure rather than added it. None of these outcomes changes Market-Residual Momentum's existing 'Interesting, unresolved' verdict in research/frozen_research_report.md by itself.
